get.summary: Get a list of all available units in a property
get.description:
Get the list of available units for a specific property and time period.
You must have this scope: 'availability.read'.

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: The property id

parameters.name: unitGroupId
parameters.description: The unit group id

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
The from date and time
A date and time (without fractional second part) in UTC or with UTC offset as defined in ISO8601:2004

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
The to date and time
A date and time (without fractional second part) in UTC or with UTC offset as defined in ISO8601:2004

parameters.name: includeOutOfService
parameters.description: Should units that are set OutOfService in the defined time period be returned as available.

parameters.name: unitCondition
parameters.description: The unit condition

parameters.name: unitAttributeIds
parameters.description: Return units with the specific unit attributes

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Default: 1. If the page has no items, the API returns 204 No Content.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page. Default: 500. Maximum: 500.

204.description: There are no available units matching your criteria.

404.description: The Request-URI could not be found.

503.description: The server is currently unavailable. Please try later.

422.description: Validation errors in the request body or query params.

get.summary: Get a list of all available unit groups in a property
get.description:
Get the list of available unit groups for a specific property and time period.
You must have this scope: 'availability.read'.

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: The property id

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the requested time period. The given day will be included in the response.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the requested time period. The given day will be included in the response.

parameters.name: timeSliceTemplate
parameters.description: The time slice template, defaults to 'over night'

parameters.name: unitGroupTypes
parameters.description: Filter result by requested unit group types

parameters.name: timeSliceDefinitionIds
parameters.description: The time slice definition ids

parameters.name: unitGroupIds
parameters.description: The unit group ids

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: The number of adults you want availability for, defaults to 1

parameters.name: childrenAges
parameters.description: The ages of the children you want availability for

parameters.name: onlySellable
parameters.description:
When set to 'true', only the unit groups sold by the specified time slice template and time slice definition ids are returned,
otherwise all unit groups are returned

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Default: 1. If the page has no items, the API returns 204 No Content.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page. Default: 500. Maximum: 500.

availableCount.description:
The number of units still available. This is the house count excluding the out of order units minus
the already sold units.

sellableCount.description:
The number of units available for selling already considering any defined overbooking limits.
This number is the minimum of sellable units for the whole property
(or house-level overbooking, if defined) and the sellable units of this unit group.
If there are only 3 units sellable on the property, but 5 units sellable for
this unit group, the sellable count will be 3. This situation can occur if another unit group
or the whole house is overbooked.
